scope: Private finite preserved two-state Block interaction; no public-profile or native gameplay promotion

implementation.resources: Three exact models and two matching variants preserved byte-for-byte
implementation.requiredOverrides: Independent source/target declaration, nearest-owner, access/finality/opcode and reopened linkage proof
implementation.materialRecipe: Existing full-cube PLAIN_BLOCK_PROPERTIES; not the half-shape operation
implementation.authority: Immutable proof/hash only; serialized bytes reopened and discarded

nativeSourceAudit.method: Bounded bytecode-as-data selection interpreter and exact-body checks; no native class loading
checked: StateHolder.cycle erased return/cast and both-value selection
Three-argument setBlock delegates same arguments with update limit 512
notProved: Dispatch, thread, reach, protection or Forge cancellation
Neighbor effects, network synchronization or native gameplay

contract.meaning: Path/schema/prerequisite consistency only; no native execution or evidence freshness inference

validation.interpretation: Counts are static test cases, not compatible mods or native behavior observations

failuresAndCorrections.finding: Initial parity test skipped simple/datapack public dispatch.
failuresAndCorrections.correction: Added six enum-profile cases through actual service.plan and service.convert; all refuse, preserve original and publish nothing.

resourceValidation.baseResourceContract: simple-content-v1; tag references restricted to local closure
differences: Target cooking recipe-book category defaults to MISC; client grouping is not validated.

recipes.reason: Pinned serializer schema and closed ingredient/result references validated; no rewrite necessary

unsupported: loot tables and global loot modifiers

limitations: Static declaration/access/dataflow checks only; no JVM class loading, Forge discovery or runtime behavior was tested.
Caller supplies complete production-namespace external declarations and separately validates external module/classloader wiring; ApiIndex has no module/nest/sealed metadata.
Cross-owner package access, nestmates, owned sealed/record/annotation classes, default-interface dispatch, native code, jsr/ret and reflective linkage are unsupported.
Constructor delegation through this(), uninitialized local aliases, branches or exception handlers with live uninitialized values are unsupported.

Only the independently re-read false-default active BooleanProperty program: logical-client SUCCESS without a write; server cycle of the actual callback state and exactly one setBlock at the callback position with flags 3, ignored boolean result, then CONSUME. Required native callbacks, inherited declarations, finality, access and opcodes are independently checked. No arbitrary interaction, other world access, write-success guarantee, main-thread/reach/protection qualification, synchronization or native gameplay execution.
